bio.text: Alan Clark, a Republican from Lonsdale, represents Arkansas Senate District 7, which includes parts of Garland, Grant, Hot Spring and Saline counties.
He was elected to the Senate in 2012 and took the oath of office in 2013; in the 95th General Assembly (2025) he chaired the Senate Judiciary Committee.
Clark served on the Garland County Quorum Court from 1992 through 1996 and is a past member of the Garland County Planning Commission.
